sources.description: May 6, 2026 - Reports on Israeli court extending detention of Thiago Ávila and Saif Abu Keshek, mother's death while son in custody, hunger strikes, and solitary confinement.
sources.label: The New Arab - Thiago Avila mourns mother's death as Israel extends detention

sources.description: May 5, 2026 - Details on court extending detention of Saif Abu Keshek and Thiago Avila, accusations of aiding enemy and Hamas links, denials of torture, demands from Spain and Brazil.
sources.label: Reuters - Israeli court extends detention of two Gaza flotilla activists until May 10

sources.description: May 3, 2026 - Reports on Spain's foreign ministry demanding immediate release, accounts of extreme brutality and torture during capture, details on interception in international waters.
sources.label: The Guardian - Spain demands release of Gaza flotilla activists 'held illegally' by Israel

sources.description: May 6, 2026 - UN OHCHR statement calling for immediate and unconditional release, stating solidarity with Palestinians and aid delivery 'is not a crime', raising alarm over abuse allegations.
sources.label: UN News - Gaza flotilla: Aid delivery 'not a crime', UN rights office tells Israel

sources.description: April 6, 2026 - Statement on Greenpeace's Arctic Sunrise joining the flotilla, framing mission as response to 'genocide, engineered starvation, and humanitarian blockade' in Gaza.
sources.label: Greenpeace MENA - Joins the 2026 Global Sumud Flotilla to Support a Humanitarian Mission to Gaza
